edges.reason: wrap() receives the recipient address argument `to`.
wrap() receives the mint `amount` argument.
wrap() receives the external `extID` argument.
extID is passed to wrapped() to check for a prior deposit.
wrap() performs the minting unsafe operation inside its body.
The minting operation invokes the overridden _mint implementation.
wrap() writes the external ID flag into _extIDs.
wrapped() reads the flag from the _extIDs mapping.
unwrap() receives the destination address string.
unwrap() receives the burn amount argument.
The destination string is validated by _isPCIAddress().
unwrap() performs the burn unsafe operation on the caller balance.
The burn target is derived from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
The wrapper argument drives role assignment through initialize(address).
The wrapper address is granted the privileged WRAPPER_ROLE in __initialize().
initialize() forwards msg.sender as the privileged wrapper account.
msg.sender receives DEFAULT_ADMIN/PAUSER/UPGRADER roles inside __initialize().
The raw address string is the input of _isPCIAddress().
The string parameter is converted to the addrBytes local variable.
The addrBytes local is consumed by the length and prefix checks in _isPCIAddress().
_beforeTokenTransfer() receives the from address argument.
_beforeTokenTransfer() receives the to address argument.
_beforeTokenTransfer() receives the amount argument.
The overridden _mint() receives the account argument.
The overridden _mint() uses amount in the totalSupply + amount <= cap() check.
_authorizeUpgrade() receives the new implementation address to authorize.
initialize() delegates setup to __initialize().
initialize(address) delegates setup to __initialize().
__initialize() grants PAUSER_ROLE to msg.sender.
__initialize() grants UPGRADER_ROLE to msg.sender.
__initialize() grants WRAPPER_ROLE to the wrapper account.
pause() is guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE).
unpause() is guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE).
wrap() is guarded by onlyRole(WRAPPER_ROLE).
_authorizeUpgrade() is guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE).
The UUPS delegatecall upgrade path is gated by the _authorizeUpgrade() hook.
Minting invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer ERC20 hook, which can revert when paused.
Burning invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer ERC20 hook, which can revert when paused.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only carries data into wrap() and has no independent role.
The wrap amount is a transient argument of the wrapping entry point.
The external ID parameter is consumed only within wrap()'s replay protection check.
The destination string is used solely inside unwrap().
The burn amount is a transient argument of unwrap().
The wrapper address parameter only drives role setup inside __initialize().
The implementation address is passed through the authorization hook.
The address string is a pure validation input of _isPCIAddress().
The from argument is a hook callback parameter with no standalone semantics.
The to argument is a hook callback parameter with no standalone semantics.
The amount argument is a hook callback parameter with no standalone semantics.
The mint target is a transient parameter of the internal mint routine.
The mint amount participates only in _mint()'s cap arithmetic.
The local byte array exists only as an intermediate inside _isPCIAddress().
